caption: The drawing depicts a single brown teapot centered on a plain, light beige background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with a pronounced midsection, a broad curved handle on the left, and a gently curving spout on the right. The top of the teapot has a circular lid with a small knob handle, and a beaded decorative pattern runs around the rim of the lid. The shading is done in various tones of brown to give the teapot a three-dimensional appearance, and there is a white highlight on the body indicating a glossy surface. Near the bottom right of the teapot, there are small red initials "M.A.R.S." on the paper. No additional objects or decorations are present in the image.
title: Teapot
